command:
python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/scons"
  "$SCONS_PYTHON" -m pip install --require-hashes -r tools/requirements-build.txt
  mkdir "$GODOT_CPP_ROOT"
  git -C "$GODOT_CPP_ROOT" init
  git -C "$GODOT_CPP_ROOT" remote add origin https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp.git
  git -C "$GODOT_CPP_ROOT" fetch --depth=1 origin "$GODOT_CPP_COMMIT"
  git -C "$GODOT_CPP_ROOT" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
  test "$(git -C "$GODOT_CPP_ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GODOT_CPP_COMMIT"

command:
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "$LLVM_MINGW_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/llvm-mingw.tar.xz"
  printf "%s  %s\n" "$LLVM_MINGW_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/llvm-mingw.tar.xz" | sha256sum --check --strict
  mkdir "$LLVM_MINGW_ROOT"
  tar -xf "$RUNNER_TEMP/llvm-mingw.tar.xz" -C "$LLVM_MINGW_ROOT" --strip-components=1
  if [ ! -e "$LLVM_MINGW_ROOT/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc-ar" ]; then
    ln -s llvm-ar "$LLVM_MINGW_ROOT/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc-ar"
  fi
record.label: llvm-mingw
